Video to MP3 Converter

Convert a video file to MP3 audio entirely in your browser. Your file never leaves your device — decoding and MP3 encoding happen locally.

Your file never leaves your device. Large videos may take a minute to decode and encode.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a video file from your device.
  2. Click "Convert to MP3" and wait while the audio is decoded and encoded.
  3. Watch the progress — large videos may take a minute or two.
  4. Your .mp3 file downloads automatically when encoding finishes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What MP3 quality do I get?

The audio is extracted with your browser's Web Audio decoder and encoded to a real MP3 at 128 kbps using the lamejs encoder.

Which video formats are supported?

Most common formats (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV audio tracks) decode fine in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If decoding fails, your browser cannot read that file's audio track.

Is my video uploaded anywhere?

Yes. The MP3 is encoded on your own device — no file is ever uploaded to a server.
